title: Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract Transfer Terms by Plan
content:
Whether a Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract plan may be transferred to a private buyer of the vehicle, the fee for doing so, and the window after the vehicle sale within which the transfer must be requested, are set by plan.

| Plan | Transfer to a private buyer allowed | Transfer fee (USD) | Transfer window (calendar days after the vehicle sale) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Powertrain | No | 0.00 | 30 |
| Kestrel Care Gold | Yes | 50.00 | 30 |
| Kestrel Care Gold Plus | Yes | 50.00 | 30 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum | Yes | 50.00 | 30 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | Yes | 50.00 | 30 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | Yes | 0.00 | 30 |

### Reading the table

- Kestrel Care Powertrain is not transferable; its fee and window figures therefore never come into play.
- Kestrel Care Platinum Elite is transferable with a fee of 0.00, so the fee collected on its transfer is 0.00.
- The window is the same 30 calendar days on every plan.
